mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.code,r.name,r.version,r.status,r.description,r.external_id,r.source_version,r.revision,r.published_at FROM routing r JOIN routing_product p ON p.routing_id=r.id JOIN material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.id=#{productId} AND m.status=#{enabledStatus} AND r.status=#{publishedStatus} AND (r.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR r.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT w.id AS workorder_id,w.planned_qty, COALESCE(SUM(e.target_qty),0) AS allocated_target_qty, w.planned_qty-COALESCE(SUM(e.target_qty),0) AS remaining_target_qty, CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(e.target_qty),0)-w.planned_qty,0) AS DECIMAL(65,6)) AS excess_target_qty, COUNT(e.id) AS execution_count FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.workorder_id=w.id WHERE w.id IN #{id} GROUP BY w.id,w.planned_qty

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_material_issue i LEFT JOIN mes_material_issue_erp_extra e ON e.id=i.id WHERE i.workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND NOT (i.status=#{voidedStatus} AND COALESCE(e.void_result_status,'')=#{succeededStatus} AND ((COALESCE(e.source_execution_mode,'')=#{localMode} AND COALESCE(e.void_execution_mode,'')=#{localMode} AND COALESCE(e.external_effect,'')=#{noneEffect}) OR (COALESCE(e.source_execution_mode,'')=#{connectedMode} AND COALESCE(e.void_execution_mode,'')=#{connectedMode} AND COALESCE(e.external_effect,'')=#{reversedEffect})))
